title: reference-impl release-prep custodian: bump to 0.7.0, update Standard dep to ^0.5.0, write CHANGELOG

acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` contains a `### Standard` subsection under the `## 0.7.0 — 2026-04-29` section that references the `task.scope.files_touched` addition.
